judgment.rationale: Both endpoints are Class X Indicators (rank 1, same coordinate) under the same parent CLO9 ('properties of metals and non-metals; reaction of metals with salt solutions; reactivity of metals; extraction of metals from their ores') and Chapter 3 – Metals and Non-metals. C29 asks learners to describe displacement reactions of Zn, Fe, Cu and Al with ZnSO4/FeSO4/CuSO4/Al2(SO4)3 (LC tags: displacement, metals, reactivity, salt solutions), which is how the relative reactivity of metals is established.
